author: Pitch Meeting
description:
Tom Holland is back in Spider-Man: Brand New Day, a sequel that strangely completely ignores the events of Madame Web.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day does raise some questions. Like are we just going to gloss over the awful stuff Jean Grey did? Why is Spider-Man so trusting? Why is there so much less CGI?!?

Maybe the answers lie inside the pitch meeting that led to Spider-Man: Brand New Day. So step inside! It’s super easy, barely an inconvenience.
